topics.title: Continuity of a function at a point and on its domain

concepts.learning_objective: Use the condition lim f(x) as x tends to c equals f(c) to decide whether a function is continuous at c.
Find unknown constants and points of discontinuity of piecewise-defined functions using one-sided limits.
Apply the sum, difference, product and quotient results for continuous functions, including polynomial and rational functions.
Use the theorem that a composite of continuous functions is continuous.

topics.title: Differentiability and its relation with continuity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that every differentiable function is continuous but a continuous function need not be differentiable.
Compute left-hand and right-hand derivatives to test differentiability at a point.

topics.title: Derivatives of composite and implicit functions

concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate composite functions using the chain rule.
Find dy/dx when x and y are related implicitly by an equation.
Recall and apply the derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions in their domains.
Simplify inverse trigonometric expressions by a suitable substitution before differentiating.
Differentiate functions involving e^x using the chain rule.
State the domain of log x and differentiate functions involving the natural logarithm.
Differentiate functions of the form [u(x)]^v(x) by taking logarithms.
Use logarithms to differentiate products and quotients of several factors.

topics.title: Parametric forms and second order derivatives

concepts.learning_objective: Find dy/dx when x and y are given in terms of a parameter.
Find second order derivatives and verify relations involving them.
